verdict.rationale: Devin's docs say you can carve out independent tasks and run them simultaneously. Each cloud session gets its own VM and keeps working after you close your laptop. A community user confirms sessions can run for literally days, and a configurable max work time governs how long they run. However, parallelism is a single thin mention, and there is no documented fleet-level launch or orchestration feature. Missing for 10: a documented fleet or batch launch-and-monitor capability, detail on concurrency limits and managing many parallel sessions, and independent corroboration of large-scale parallel runs.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can launch fleets of autonomous agents that work in parallel on different tasks for hours or days

citations.quote: Carve out independent tasks and run them simultaneously.
The cloud session gets its own VM with a shell, browser, and full repo access, so it can keep going after you close your laptop.
it would work away for literally days on a task
You can set a 'max work time' before Devin pauses so it won't go for days endlessly spending your credits.
